newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bank Melbourne completes Challenge buy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bank Melbourne completes Challenge buy.

text.p: Bank of Melbourne Ltd (BOM) said on Monday that it had completed the purchase and integration of the assets of Westpac Banking Corp unit Challenge Bank in the state of Victoria.
The price on completion was A$645 million, comprising net assets of A$576 million plus a premium of A$69 million.
BOM initially estimated a price of A$800 million when it announced the purchase in May.
Chief executive officer David Airey told Reuters a strong rise in Challenge Victoria's retail deposit levels had helped reduce the purchase price.
Airey also said BOM had closed 15 Challenge branches and three of its own over the weekend as part of the integration of Challenge.
Airey said it was too early to know what savings would flow from the closures.
"It's too early to judge. The benefit of the cost savings to Bank of Melbourne will not accrue until the second half," he said.
